{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Bureau of Resource Research''' was an agency of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] which operated during the reign of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pandur]] commissioned [[Obo Rin]] to write a ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]'' for the Empire, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Herrit]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] objected that any of the dozens of expert [[sentientologist]]s employed by the Imperial Bureau of Resource Research would be more qualified to lead the project. As expressed in his communiqué to Lord Vader, Herrit was also of the opinion that the Bureau's experts would be more competent and thorough.
